scripts.build: esbuild server.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=dist/server.mjs --minify --sourcemap --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url); globalThis.__INDEXER_IMPORTED_IN_SERVER__ = true;" && esbuild indexer-cli.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=dist/indexer-cli.mjs --minify --sourcemap --external:sharp && mkdir -p dist/src/indexer/data && cp -r src/indexer/data/* dist/src/indexer/data/
scripts.ship: npm run pack && npm publish --access public
scripts.bun:arm64: npm run bun:deps:arm64 && npm run build && bun build dist/server.mjs --compile --target=bun-windows-arm64 --asset=node_modules/@img/sharp-win32-arm64 --outfile=TravelAlbums-arm64.exe
scripts.bun:win32: npm run bun:deps:x64 && npm run build && bun build dist/server.mjs --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --asset=node_modules/@img/sharp-win32-x64 --outfile=TravelAlbums-win32.exe
scripts.bun:package: npm run bun:arm64 && npm run bun:win32
